name: vg-brain-capture
description: Voyageur Group — VG Brain automatic session capture. A restricted add-on, kept in its own marketplace so it never appears in the plugin list of people who should not have it.

plugins.name: vg-brain-capture
plugins.description: Automatic session capture for VG Brain. Uploads every Claude Code session to your OWN notes at session end, before a compact, and on catch-up after a missed upload. Nothing is shared by being captured. Install ALONGSIDE the vg-brain plugin, never instead of it: the base plugin carries the connection, the search tools and the session-start context, and this adds only the uploading.
